explanation: Active only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 by a common transition: about 10 if that trial was rewarded (around 7 later in the episode, after trial 40 or so), about 7-8 if it was not rewarded, and lower again (5, then 1) for each further unrewarded trial in a row. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at D1 whenever the previous trial was a1 or had a rare transition, rewarded or not.
